title: Free $50 Visa Gift Card
description: Enter to win a Free $50 Visa Gift Card when you ask me to referral you to an expert to help you!   That's right, ask me who I recommend for Heating and Cooling, Plumber, Financial Services, Dentist or more than 100 different business categories and you will be entered to win!

asr.full_text: Hi, Kevin Higgins here, your roving real estate reporter with a special offer for you. How would you like to win a $50 gift card from Visa and an opportunity to meet Tom Hanks in person? Wouldn't that be great? Well, I probably can't get you introduced to Tom Hanks, but I can share with you how to win a $50 Visa gift card, and it's really simple. Let me tell you, I'm a proud member of the Local Business Network, and I'm on a mission to refer out to my network of professionals, like chiropractors and dentists and financial planners, plumbers and heating and cooling planners, plumbers, and heating and cooling people, moving and storage people, I want to send out 150 referrals next year in 2015. So, I am doing an awareness campaign right now. What I want to do is help you and your friends when they need a professional. They don't know who to call. Call me, Kevin Higgins, so I can refer you to those people to help you. When you get referred, I'm going to enter you in a monthly drawing to win one of these $50 Visa gift cards. Again, sorry about the Tom Hanks thing. But who knows? Maybe I can work on an introduction, but in the interim, call me, contact me for your referrals, and I will put you in the monthly drawing And I'm starting right now the end of November currently 2014 through the end of December when our first drawing so start sending me those referrals now and win one of these and Thanks very much. God bless you

textual.observation: The speaker promotes entry into a monthly drawing for a $50 Visa gift card in exchange for viewers contacting him for referrals to professionals, while stating membership in the Local Business Network.

evidence.quote: Enter to win a Free $50 Visa Gift Card when you ask me to referral you to an expert to help you!
I'm a proud member of the Local Business Network
call me, contact me for your referrals, and I will put you in the monthly drawing

textual.context: Presented as a promotional awareness campaign for referrals to professionals and a monthly drawing; the supplied records do not establish whether the claimed network affiliation or drawing operates as described.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised gift card is directly linked to contacting the speaker and obtaining or sending professional referrals, creating a reward-for-action relationship that may require assessment of the promotion's terms and operation.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish payment, required sensitive information, actual referral outcomes, drawing results, eligibility details, or whether the speaker is authorized to represent the named network or professionals.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker explicitly limits the claim about meeting Tom Hanks and apologizes for raising that possibility.

evidence.quote: I probably can't get you introduced to Tom Hanks
Again, sorry about the Tom Hanks thing.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a referral-awareness promotion offering entry into a monthly $50 Visa gift-card drawing for referrals to professionals. The described activity includes no payment requirement, sensitive-data request, completed transaction, or deceptive outcome, and the mention of meeting Tom Hanks is qualified as probably unavailable rather than presented as a promised benefit.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an ordinary referral promotion and giveaway: viewers are offered entry into a monthly drawing for a $50 Visa gift card when they contact the speaker for professional referrals. The supplied evidence does not show payment, sensitive-data collection, or a bypass mechanism.
